items.impact: Archival Collections will not be processed and not made avaialable for park and public use. Preserving the collection and providing for collection access, use and interpretation are primary responsibiities of the musuem program.

items.title: Photographing museum collections for preservation and increased accessibility
items.impact: Without this agreement, critical collections remain undocumented and inaccessible, delaying preservation work and limiting public engagement. Digital stewardship goals stall and long standing documentation gaps persist. The park loses essential support for protecting, interpreting, and providing access to irreplaceable museum resources.

items.title: Zion Cultural Resources
items.impact: If this project is not completed, significant cultural sites in Zion National Park may remain unidentified, undocumented, or at risk of damage. Gaps in research, preservation planning, and management guidance would hinder informed decision-making, potentially resulting in permanent loss of cultural heritage and reduced protection for historic structures.

items.title: Youth Geographic Information System (GIS) and Resource Mapping Support at Zion National Park
items.listing: 15.931 Youth and Veteran Organizations Conservation Projects
items.impact: Without funding, the parks will lack updated maps and accurate resource data, limiting staff’s ability to make informed decisions and respond quickly during emergencies such as fires or search-and-rescue events.

items.title: Museum and Archives Collaboration
items.impact: If this project is not awarded, addressing inaccurate collection information will not be possible, leading to unreliable data for determining the needs of the collections, decreased efficiency, and increased time wasted on piecemeal solutions to these problems.
